patterns.note: An asymmetrical hero section features a large, dynamically scaling title and abstract imagery, transitioning into a single-column, left-aligned content layout for subsequent sections.

A strong typographic contrast is established between an expansive, bold sans-serif for primary display titles and a refined, elegant serif for body text and sub-headings, with uppercase used for navigation and labels.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is used for text and primary backgrounds, punctuated by a soft, cool mint green for alternating background sections to define content blocks.

The main site title dynamically scales down and repositions to become a sticky header upon scroll, with its text content changing at a specific scroll depth. A persistent navigation bar remains fixed at the bottom of the viewport.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, mint green, black), creating a visual rhythm as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-triggered animation system (e.g., using `locomotive-scroll` or a similar library) to achieve several dynamic effects: the initial hero title scales down and transitions its position to become a sticky header, the sticky header's text content dynamically changes based on scroll position, and content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. A persistent navigation bar should remain fixed at the bottom of the screen.

Establish a clear typographic hierarchy by pairing a bold, wide sans-serif for display headings with a contrasting elegant serif for body and supporting text. Adjust letter-spacing and line-height to enhance readability and visual impact for each font style.
Define distinct content sections by alternating full-width background colors (white, a soft mint green, and black) to create visual rhythm and clear separation between different content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Expansive, bold display headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter-spacing, contrasted with a refined serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (rounded corners on buttons and input fields, typically 8-12px).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a balanced rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of scroll-triggered transformations, particularly the dynamic scaling and content-changing header, combined with a persistent bottom navigation, creates a unique and engaging browsing experience. This approach elevates a minimalist design with unexpected interactive elements.
